description: This file contains a class FrameLogger which extends FrameProcessor to add logging capabilities for frames passing through a pipeline. It provides configurable logging for debugging and monitoring frame flow in Pipecat pipelines, and references various frame types and processing classes.

classes.name: FrameLogger
classes.description: A frame processor that logs frame information for debugging purposes, capable of filtering specific frame types and customizing log appearance.
